verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a 'flexible data export' as part of its team-performance reporting. That is a product-native export capability, but it is scoped to reporting data, and no formats or full-account coverage are documented. The JSON list endpoints in the Uptime API are a developer building block for building an export, not a turnkey export, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented export of all data (logs, metrics, incidents, monitors, status pages), explicit open formats (CSV/JSON/OTLP), an account-exit or offboarding workflow, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Robust one-click reporting on your team's performance with a flexible data export.
